name: Sarah Rosenkrantz
tagline: Software developer and outdoors enthusiast and lifelong learner.
bio: I work as a software engineer at Deutsche Bank on the AI enablement team. Outside of work, I serve on the board of Muddy Sneakers, a nonprofit focused on outdoor education. A proud NC State grad, I’m passionate about solving problems, exploring new ideas, and finding ways to make a difference. Outside of work, I enjoy playing beach volleyball, backpacking, and getting lost in a good book.
